separate_technical_variants: E6R vs E6CR: CANNOT be demonstrated technically identical from official evidence. The only official data are the EEA rows, whose published fields (Ep 239, M 1825, Mt 1905, Z 142, Zr 448, W 2875, At1/At2 1580, Ve PGB1S5N/PGB1S5T1 shared) are equal, but equal values are not proof of identity (brief rule) and the Va code itself is the type-approval authority's variant designation — a different Va means a different approved variant within E4*2007/46*1293. They also sit under different TAN revisions (E6R: *13/*15; E6CR: *17/*18/*19), occupy disjoint registration windows (E6R last seen 2021-06-29, E6CR first seen 2021-08-03), and E6CR also appears with Ve PQB1S5N which E6R never has. No official document (CoC, type-approval extension, Tesla technical sheet, IDAE code) explaining the 'C' in E6CR was found. => Keep E6R and E6CR as SEPARATE technical ReferenceVariants (they may share the same commercial name and specs values).
E6R/PB1S5N and E6R/PB1S5T1 (TAN*13, Zr=440 km, Dr 2021-01-04→06-28) differ in Ve and in Zr from E6R/PGB1S5N (TAN*15, Zr=448): separate versions; do not fold into the 448 km record.

E1LR (BGB1S5N/BGB1S5T1; 208 kW, 140 Wh/km, 448 km, M 1700) and E1R (BB1N; 208 kW, 149 Wh/km, 409 km, M 1684): different Va and different Ep/M — separate technical variants even if sold under the SR+ name.
E3R (BB1N; 225 kW, 600 km): other RWD Va seen in ES 2021, clearly not SR+.

E6LR (TAN*19: 491 km, 144 Wh/km, M 1825, from 2021-11-11; TAN*20: 495 km, M 1835, December 2021): the December 2021 'Tracción trasera' family — separate ReferenceVariant; even within E6LR the *19 (491 km) and *20 (495 km, 1835 kg) rows differ and must not be merged by name. IDAE 562353 (491 km, 14,4 kWh) matches E6LR*19 only by values (UNCONFIRMED).
missing_for_upgrade: An official document that maps the commercial trim to a Va/Ve: e.g. an EU Certificate of Conformity of a Spanish-registered 2021 SR+ (fields 0.2 type/variant/version), the type-approval extension documents of E4*2007/46*1293*13..*19 (RDW, approval authority E4) describing variants E6R and E6CR, or an IDAE/DGT record carrying the code. Such a CoC per Va would give PARTIAL/EXACT per variant; a type-approval extension document stating what distinguishes E6CR from E6R would settle whether they are technically identical.
notes: Registrations of the 448 km phase in EEA (Zr=448, Ep=239): E6R 103 (*15) + E6CR 132 (*17/*18/*19). The commercial 448 km window (2021-01-28→2021-11-01) overlaps both E6R (*13 rows show Zr=440, not 448, until 2021-06-28) and E6CR, so the SR+ commercial name maps to at least two technical variants; a used-car instance must be resolved by its own CoC/registration Va+Ve, not by name.
